pricing.metaDescription: Calculate the ideal selling price of your product by entering COGS (HPP), monthly fixed operational costs, tax schemes (UMKM/PPN), and get accurate BEP units.
pricing.title: Business Pricing & BEP Calculator
pricing.description: Calculate profitable selling prices considering HPP (COGS), fixed operational costs, target volumes, and Indonesian tax regulations.
pricing.hppHelp: Cost of goods sold / pure production cost per unit.
pricing.volumeHelp: Estimated number of units sold per month.
pricing.marginHelp: Markup profit percentage based on total cost.
pricing.bepDesc: Units sold per month to break even
pricing.dos1: Track every single tiny expense (like packaging tape, plastic wraps, sales internet quota) into COGS so it does not erode your profit margin.
pricing.dos2: Research competitors' pricing so the recommended price from the calculator remains highly competitive in the market.
pricing.donts1: Do not ignore your own salary. Business owners must include their salary allocation within the Fixed Operational Costs.
pricing.donts2: Do not use overly optimistic sales volume targets during the initial phase of your business.

tanah.metaDescription: Simulate costs associated with land transactions in Indonesia. Calculate seller's Final PPh, buyer's BPHTB tax, notary/PPAT fees, and bank financing options.
tanah.title: Land Transaction Calculator
tanah.description: Estimate seller tax (PPh Final), buyer tax (BPHTB), PPAT notary fees, land title transfer (BBN), and bank KPT mortgage simulations.
tanah.methodArea: Based on Area & Price per m²
tanah.nptkpDesc: (DKI Jakarta first acquisition is Rp350m, other regions are generally Rp60m)
tanah.edu1: 1. Verify land certificate authenticity at the local BPN office to ensure no ongoing legal disputes.
tanah.edu2: 2. Agree on notary/PPAT fees sharing and proceed with the drafting of Sale & Purchase Deed (AJB).
tanah.edu3: 3. Pay Final PPh (Seller) and BPHTB (Buyer) taxes via bank transfers using E-Billing code.
tanah.edu4: 4. Notary submits files to BPN to register the Title Transfer Certification (BBN).
tanah.dos1: Always check certificate validity (plotting) at the local BPN office before paying the DP to ensure the land is free of disputes.
tanah.dos2: Clearly write a written agreement regarding notary fee division from the very beginning of the transaction.
tanah.donts1: Never use informal hand receipts without involving an official PPAT notary due to high legal risks.
tanah.donts2: Do not engage in under-invoicing (falsifying/lowering transaction price in the deed to pay lower taxes) as it is a major legal violation.

rumah.metaDescription: Simulate the total purchase cost of a house in Indonesia via cash or KPR mortgage loan. Includes dynamic KPR insurance estimates, reserved balance, and monthly repayments.
rumah.title: House Purchase & KPR Calculator
rumah.description: Simulate upfront cash requirements for buyers, BPHTB tax, and dynamic KPR bank loan costs based on age, insurance, and mandatory holding balances.
rumah.ageHelp: Affects bank's dynamic mortgage life insurance rate.
rumah.dos1: Pay careful attention to the KPR Fixed Rate period and be financially prepared for when rates start to rise following the market (Floating Rate).
rumah.dos2: Inspect physical building structures meticulously (retention check) before signing the key handover certificate.
rumah.donts1: Do not ignore the mandatory holding balance requested by the bank, which often causes mortgage execution day failures.
rumah.donts2: Do not take a monthly installment value exceeding 30% of your total net monthly income.

menabung.metaDescription: Compute your future savings using compound interest simulations. Adjust for bank interest tax and monthly administrative fees.
menabung.title: Savings & Compound Interest Calculator
menabung.description: Simulate long-term compound interest with accurate bank tax and monthly administrative fee deductions.
menabung.rate: Interest Rate / Annual Return (% per Year)
menabung.taxToggle: Interest Tax Option (20% for Conventional Banks)
menabung.dos1: Set up an automatic debit (Autodebet) directly on your payday to maintain savings discipline consistently.
menabung.dos2: Understand the effect of inflation; if your savings interest rate is below annual inflation, your real purchasing power is actually shrinking.
menabung.donts1: Avoid saving small amounts in conventional bank accounts with high administrative fees, as your balance will get eaten up by monthly charges.
menabung.donts2: Never mix your core savings account with your daily operational shopping card/account.

investasi.metaDescription: Comparatively analyze and calculate your investment returns. Evaluate stock dividends, Antam gold buyback profits, SBN coupons, and bank deposit interest.
investasi.title: Multi-Asset Investment Calculator
investasi.description: Compute your investment performance across multiple assets: Dividend stocks, physical gold, Government Bonds (SBN), and fixed deposits.
investasi.sahamTax: Dividend Tax (10% if cashed out, 0% if reinvested)
investasi.dos1: Track the Cum Date carefully if you invest for stock dividends; you must hold the stock until the market closes on that day.
investasi.dos2: Regard physical gold investments as long-term holds (3-5 years) to act as inflation hedges rather than short-term trading assets.
investasi.donts1: Never use 'Hot Money' (such as school fees or money borrowed from online lenders) to enter volatile investment instruments.
investasi.donts2: Do not fall into FOMO (Fear of Missing Out) and buy financial assets solely because they are viral without looking at fundamentals.

depresiasi.metaDescription: Simulate the future resale value of vehicles, laptops, and gadgets using the Declining Balance method combined with first-year shock drops.
depresiasi.title: Consumer Asset Depreciation Calculator
depresiasi.description: Simulate depreciation rates of your assets over time using the Declining Balance method with first-year shock drop factors reflecting the Indonesian market.
depresiasi.comfortFeeDesc: (Depreciation cost that you pay per month)
depresiasi.dos1: Become aware of the monthly 'Comfort Fee' showing from the calculator to assess whether the utility of the item warrants its depreciation value.
depresiasi.dos2: Maintain your assets in top condition (maintain regular service records and physical protectors) to fetch higher resale values in the market.
depresiasi.donts1: Do not purchase brand new vehicles using long-term consumer debt (>5 years), as the asset's value depreciates much faster than your outstanding debt principal.
depresiasi.donts2: Do not treat electronic consumer goods as forms of investment, as technology cycles move aggressively.
